findings.impact: the clobbered path is the JSON feeding the L1's corrections section for R54.10, one of C1's ten classes. It was destroyed, restored by peer session-log replay, and destroyed again 3 minutes later by a different co-writer - the defect recurs for every co-writer that lands
findings.recommendation: item 10 -> T55W1ScribeNote.md; 12 -> T55W1ScribeCells.{json,md}; 14 -> T55W1ScribeSources.{json,md}; 19 -> T55W1ScribeConsiderthese.md; 21 -> T55W1ScribeMistakeSweep.md; 29 -> T55W1ExecRekeyPrep.json; add a build-time assertion that the set of deliverable paths has cardinality 75 and each deliverable shares its item's name prefix; and have the L1 restore the R54.10 JSON from the peer session log before integrating
